text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As the year's end drew near—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Duramente-san is?
choice_data_list: Yeah, they asked you to come.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...What could it be...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Duramente had insisted on me bringing Admire Groove
to the cafeteria at this exact time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I was also asked not to reveal the reason, so—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: C-Congratulations...!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Admire Groove... That's "CONG", right.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Alv.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Arve-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...If this is to celebrate 'back-to-back Queen Elizabeth II Cup wins,'
I thought you already did that for me?"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"That is not the case.
This is for achieving the Triple Tiara."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...That was last year, you know?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Whether it was last year or the year before doesn't matter.
This great achievement deserves to be properly celebrated.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: However...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I figured you'd hold back if you knew, so I had them bring you here without explaining the situation.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ......So you knew, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Respect should be given to those who hone themselves and achieve great deeds.
Alv-senpai... that goes for you, too."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Besides, so much happened last year that we couldn't properly celebrate.
Take your time and savor it this time around.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
“...... All right.
I'll take you up on your offer this time, then.”

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hahaa! Now I'm really getting into it!
Bring me another glass of carrot juice!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...What is she doing?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Umm... it seems it's a celebratory dance...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Well, the Christmas spirit is still lingering, after all.
Maybe it's like riding the wave for one more celebration!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: There really are some peculiar people out there, aren't there...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Still—looks like there's someone here
who didn't just come along for the ride, huh?
I'll see myself out, take your time~

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Still-san...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: —To think that I, who had lost all hope back then, am here sharing drinks and chatting with you at a celebration... It feels so surreal.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
The new days I discovered after that defeat...
I hold them dearly now.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"However... there were indeed things...
that I had left behind that day."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I came here... to retrieve what was left behind.
And so, from me to you, Alv-sanâ

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ――A "Congratulations."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: —...Even if I reach out my hand... it's all in the past...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
“—With this, I too can live in the present
with 'that person'... to the absolute fullest.”

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...You're strong, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Then I suppose I should say it too.
...'Thank you'..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
We both still seem a bit awkward with each other, don't we?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"However... from here on, I will not yield.
In order to grasp a new happiness."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
Sounds good, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: But... I won't yield to you either.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Because I... have a reason to win too.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: So――when that time comes, let's go all out again.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
From now on, as many times as it takes—
